name: Kevin Bussema

bio.statement: Maywood Park's council and staff page lists Kevin Bussema as council president.
In his voters' pamphlet statement, Bussema lists his occupation as small business owner and background as a nonprofit executive.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists a BBA from Western Michigan University.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet statement, Nov 3 2026)
